document:
Engineer scratchpad - uncontrolled

- Remember: EP-03 current is RMS phasor magnitude. Scope screenshot from bench uses peak scale, so 2 Arms would be 2.828 A peak if converted to instantaneous sine amplitude.
- Old v1 model sigma=0.05 is not release truth.
- Useful/core = 1 - sigma. With sigma=.08 -> .92.
- Gap + leakage are parallel: same magnetic voltage, different flux.
- Do not put total Phi_core into gap B calculation.
- Physical prototype measured ~1.58 mm gap, but analytic case is 1.50 mm.
- Excitation induced U is positive orientation; measurement coil negative. Magnitudes are both proportional to ramp.
- Linear benchmark only. Saturation discussion belongs to a separate nonlinear inductor case.
